text:
marie: Rolling the kernel+driver+NCCL patch to the eu-west H100 pool now. Notes mentioned SM90 PTX optimizations — I'll watch for regressions. /deploy started.

deploy-bot: deploy: job/infra-h100-eu-west/patch-2026-03-17 succeeded in 3m12s

jon: seeing 5 nodes flapping in the autoscaler within 10m (nodes h100-eu-10..14 in eu-west-1b). Pods evicted, a few runtime pods showing io/linker errors.

marie: getting linker errors from nvptx JIT on container start — pasting snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:23Z] runtime: jit: link failed: PTX_VER mismatch for sm_90
E nvrtc: ptx linking failed: incompatible compute capability for module 'transformer_kv'
```

leo: odd — failures only on dedicated H100s with driver 535.101. Are any nodes still on 535.65?

priya: @infra-oncall can you cordon/drain affected nodes? We're seeing latency up ~30% for some embedding jobs.

infra-oncall: draining the affected nodes now, 6 pods rescheduled. Autoscaler spawned some preemptible nodes then cleaned them up which caused a cost blip — cordoning one node for forensics.

jon: customer impact: embedding pipelines backlogged and some sync jobs retrying. I suspect KV cache invalidation on restart contributes to latency spike.

marie: hypothesis: the newer driver enforces stricter PTX compatibility checks. Our SM90 kernels were compiled with nvcc from toolchain v12.2 producing PTX that 535.101 rejects. Repro attempt: try same image on older driver.

leo: quick test — non-prod h100 with 535.65 loads the same image fine. On 535.101 I reproduce the PTX link error. Regression introduced between 535.65 and 535.101 (likely 535.80+). Opening vendor ticket.

marie: opened VENDOR-9876 with stack trace and sample module. Also starting staged rollback to 535.65 on a small canary set in eu-west.

deploy-bot: rollback: driver-rollout/eu-west -> 535.65 initiated by marie.

priya: if rollback succeeds we should add a runbook to pin driver minimums for model-serving images and a preflight compile+run for SM90. Otherwise we'll keep oscillating.

jon: note — also seeing NCCL warnings on mixed-driver groups: 'ncclCommInitRank: NVLink negotiation failed / unmatched topo' on nodes that negotiated across driver versions. That might explain intermittent cross-node hangs.

marie: important: NVLink groups must be homogeneous for driver/KSYMS. I'll add a constraint to the rollout orchestration to avoid mixed-driver coexistence in the same NVLink domain.

leo: temporary workaround attempts (env toggles like TORCH_NVRTC_DISABLE) are flaky. Prefer rollback.

infra-oncall: rollback completed on 8 canary nodes; smoke tests passed (small inference, nccl allreduce sample). Autoscaler behavior stabilized; cost trend decreasing.

priya: next steps: add canary job that compiles a small SM90 kernel and runs a short inference during driver canaries, add a driver->kernel compatibility matrix to the Console, and update docs to clearly state driver minimums for SM90 workloads.

marie: thanks — monitoring for 2 hours. If green we'll schedule a controlled fleet-wide rollback and update the rollout pipeline to gate by the new canary. Will update VENDOR-9876 with our findings and attach the failing PTX samples.

leo: filing an internal follow-up to scan images for nvrtc/ptx usage and mark ones that need arch-specific cubins.

jon: FYI we should also check Dedicated vs Hosted capacity policies — Dedicated pools saw most hits; Hosted fallback routing may have masked larger outage.

marie: noted. Will sync with product on fallback policies and update runbooks. :thumbsup:
